NachOS

Notchmaxxing

Your notch isn't a flaw: it's a bite. NachOS turns it into an island like the iPhone's, with everything you need one pointer move away.

Download for Mac Free · macOS 14 Sonoma or later · Apple silicon and Intel · With or without a notch

Everything, beside the notch.

Move the pointer over the notch and the island opens. Move away and it hides again.

An island in your notch.

Music, windows, tray, calendar, timers, weather and games, each in its own tab. No windows to hunt for, no icons to open.

Windows your way.

Drag a window to the notch and drop it into a half, a third or a corner. Then drag the line between two windows to share the space. And save scenes to place several apps at once.

⌘C

A clipboard that remembers.

Everything you copy stays in the tray, ready to paste again. Drop files on the notch and take them wherever you like later.

The island lets you know.

The song playing, a countdown, your charger, your AirPods or your next meeting show up beside the notch without opening anything. Click a notice to go where it points.

Installing, the first time.

Drag NachOS to Applications. Since it's free and doesn't go through Apple's paid review yet, macOS asks for your permission the first time you open it.

  1. NachOS
    NachOS
    →
    Applications

    Drag it to Applications.

    Open NachOS.dmg from Downloads and drag NachOS to the Applications folder.

  2. “NachOS” Not Opened

    Apple could not verify “NachOS” is free of malware that may harm your Mac or compromise your privacy.

    DoneMove to Bin

    Open it and click “Done”.

    macOS will say it can't check it. That's expected: click “Done”, don't move it to the Bin.

  3. GeneralPrivacy & SecurityDesktop & Dock
    Security

    “NachOS” was blocked to protect your Mac.

    Open Anyway

    Open System Settings.

    Go to Privacy & Security, scroll down to Security and click “Open Anyway” next to NachOS.

  4. Open “NachOS”?

    macOS cannot verify the developer of “NachOS”. Are you sure you want to open it?

    Open AnywayCancel

    Confirm.

    Click “Open Anyway” again and enter your password or use Touch ID. Done: from now on it opens like any other app.

The wording may vary slightly with your version of macOS. Updates arrive on their own from the app, without these steps.

Your Mac, your stuff.

No accounts, no ads and no usage statistics.

Everything stays on your Mac

  • Your clipboard, your files and your scenes never leave it.
  • Anything password managers copy is ignored.
  • Only the song's details, to find its lyrics; your approximate location, for the weather; and, once a day, a check for a new version go out to the internet.

Permissions, when they're needed

  • Each feature asks for its permission the first time you use it, never at launch.
  • Accessibility is only used to move windows and, if you turn it on, to read other apps' notices.
  • Every update is signed, and checked before it's installed.
